rewrite: Investigate why the failing test(s) are failing. Run the test suite, capture the full error output, identify the root cause (assertion failure, exception, timeout, or environment issue), and propose a fix. Show the failing test name and the exact error message.
debug_notes: Critique pass: 'check why the test fails' is ambiguous — which test? The rewrite assumes the user means the currently failing test(s) in the project's suite, which is the most common intent. Alternative interpretation: a specific test the user is actively editing. If conversation history contains a specific test name, prefer it. Revision: rewrite stays general but instructs the executor to identify the test by name in its output, covering both cases.
__notes__: mode MUST be 'debug'. '!debug' is the first whitespace-separated token.
The rewrite must NOT contain the '!debug' token — it is stripped before construction.
debug_notes MUST be non-empty. It must contain at least one explicit critique-revise pass (bounded staged reasoning).
The debug_notes content above is illustrative — exact wording may vary, but the structure (critique → revision decision) must be present.
Acceptable route variations: agent:build-error-resolver, agent:investigate (investigate skill), tdd-workflow skill, native tools (fallback).
In debug mode, the wrapper shows the rewrite in a fenced block before executing (same as verbose) AND surfaces debug_notes to the user.
